Utilities

Utilities apps for Omarchy

233 packages from the official Omarchy repository.

Independent editorial guide

Short answer

Install any of these with omarchy pkg add <name>. The list below has all 233 utilities packages in the official repo as of 2026-11-25.

What you will find here

The Utilities group has 233 packages in the official Omarchy repository. Examples include amp-cli (Amp, the frontier coding agent, in your terminal), amp-desktop-bin (Amp, the frontier coding agent, as a desktop app) and antigravity (Google Antigravity 2.0 agent-first desktop app). Install any of them with omarchy pkg add followed by the package name. Categories are this site's own grouping; the packages and versions come from pkgs.omarchy.org.
